name: mid
description: Extracts a substring from a string.
syntax: mid( string string, number start, [number count] )

params.name: string
params.description: Must be single-quotation mark or double-quotation mark delimited.

params.name: start
params.description: The position of the first character to retrieve.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of characters to retrieve. If not set, all characters until the end of the string will be returned.
